'''Jieping Zhu''' (祝介平; born 1965 in [[Xiaoshan District|Xiaoshan]], [[Hangzhou]], [[China]]) is an organic chemist specializing in natural product total synthesis and [[Organometallic chemistry|organometallics]]. He is a professor of chemistry at [[École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne|EPFL]] (École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne) and the head of the Laboratory of Synthesis and Natural Products.<ref>{{Cite web|title=LSPN|url=https://www.epfl.ch/labs/lspn/|access-date=2021-04-13|website=www.epfl.ch|language=en-GB}}</ref>

== Career ==
Zhu studied chemistry at [[Hangzhou Normal University]] and at [[Lanzhou University]], both in China. He then joined [[Henri-Philippe Husson]] and [[Jean-Charles Quirion]] to pursue a PhD in [[organic chemistry]] at the Institute de Chimie des Substances Naturelles at the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research]].<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Zhu|first1=Jieping|last2=Quirion|first2=Jean Charles|last3=Husson|first3=Henri Philippe|date=November 1993|title=Asymmetric synthesis. 29. Preparation of 1,8-diazaspiro[5.5]undecane derivatives|url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/abs/10.1021/jo00075a048|journal=The Journal of Organic Chemistry|language=en|volume=58|issue=23|pages=6451–6456|doi=10.1021/jo00075a048|issn=0022-3263|url-access=subscription}}</ref> In 1991, he graduated with a thesis on ''Synthèse asymétrique de dérivés de l'histrionicotoxine et de spiropipéridines apparentées'' (Asymmetric synthesis of histrionicotoxin derivatives and related spiropiperidines).<ref>{{Cite book|last1=Zhu|first1=Jieping|url=https://pascal-francis.inist.fr/vibad/index.php?action=getRecordDetail&idt=144827|title=Synthèse asymétrique de dérivés de l'histrionicotoxine et de spiropipéridines apparentées|last2=Husson|first2=Henri-Philippe|date=1991}}</ref>

As a postdoctoral researcher he went to work with [[Derek Barton]] at the [[Texas A&M University]] and pursue research on [[Phosphorous acid|phosphonic acid]] synthesis.<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Barton|first1=Derek H. R.|last2=Zhu|first2=Jieping|date=March 1993|title=Elemental white phosphorus as a radical trap: a new and general route to phosphonic acids|url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/abs/10.1021/ja00058a082|journal=Journal of the American Chemical Society|language=en|volume=115|issue=5|pages=2071–2072|doi=10.1021/ja00058a082|bibcode=1993JAChS.115.2071B |issn=0002-7863|url-access=subscription}}</ref> In 1992, he joined [[Institut de Chimie des Substances Naturelles]] (ICSN) as a [[Academic ranks in France|chargé de recherche]]. In 2000, he was promoted to directeur de recherche  2nd class, then 1st class in 2006 in the same institute.

Since 2010, he has been full professor of chemistry at [[École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne|EPFL]]'s School of Basic Sciences of EPFL.

== Distinctions ==
Zhu is the recipient of among others the 2016 Natural Product Chemistry Award from the [[Royal Society of Chemistry]] (RSC) Natural Product Chemistry Award,<ref>{{Cite journal|date=2016|title=Royal Society of Chemistry Prizes and Awards 2016|url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1002/anie.201605977|journal=Angewandte Chemie International Edition|volume=55|issue=35|pages=10181–10182|doi=10.1002/anie.201605977|pmid=27385199 |bibcode=2016ACIE...5510181. |issn=1521-3773|url-access=subscription}}</ref> the 2010 Division of Organic Chemistry (Prix SCF-DCO) award from the [[Société chimique de France]] (French Chemical Society),<ref>{{Cite web|title=Lauréats - Société Chimique de France|url=https://www.societechimiquedefrance.fr/Laureats-896.html?lang=fr|access-date=2021-04-14|website=www.societechimiquedefrance.fr|archive-date=2021-04-14|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210414085009/https://www.societechimiquedefrance.fr/Laureats-896.html?lang=fr|url-status=dead}}</ref> the 2009 [[Changjiang Scholars Program|Chang Jiang Scholars]] (Qinghua University) awarded by the Chinese Ministry of Education, the 2009 Silver Medal of [[French National Centre for Scientific Research|CNRS]],<ref>{{Cite web|title=Jieping Zhu {{!}} CNRS|url=https://www.cnrs.fr/institut_inc/en/node/872|access-date=2021-04-14|website=www.cnrs.fr|date=January 2009 |language=en}}</ref> the 2008 Novartis Chemistry Lectureship, the 2004 Liebig Lectureship of the German Chemical Society,<ref>{{Cite web|title=Liebig-Lectureship {{!}} Gesellschaft Deutscher Chemiker e.V.|url=https://www.gdch.de/netzwerk-strukturen/fachstrukturen/liebig-vereinigung-fuer-organische-chemie/liebig-lectureship.html|access-date=2021-04-14|website=www.gdch.de|language=de}}</ref> and the 2003 Prix “Emile Jungfleisch” of [[French Academy of Sciences|French Academy of Science]].<ref>{{Cite journal|date=2013|title=Jieping Zhu|url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1002/anie.201210061|journal=Angewandte Chemie International Edition|volume=52|issue=27|pages=6812–6813|doi=10.1002/anie.201210061|bibcode=2013ACIE...52.6812. |issn=1521-3773|url-access=subscription}}</ref>

He is a  fellow of the [[Royal Society of Chemistry]]. He is editor at the journal Tetrahedron Letters.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Professor Jieping Zhu|url=https://www.journals.elsevier.com/tetrahedron-letters/editorial-board/professor-jieping-zhu|access-date=2021-04-14|website=Elsevier}}</ref>
